name: 会话时间线
description: 顶栏时钟按钮弹出跨项目的会话时间线：扫描 pi 会话目录下所有项目的历史会话，按修改时间由新到旧排列（带项目分组），点会话标题即可跳转——跨项目会话先自动切换工作区（走宿主原生目录授权确认）。左栏另有可折叠的「会话时间线」分区（卡片样式，同「运行的对话」）。
descriptionEn: A topbar clock button opens a cross-project session timeline: scans every project's history sessions under the pi sessions dir, lists them newest first (grouped by project), and clicking a title jumps to it — cross-project entries switch the workspace first (with the host's native directory-authorization confirm). The left sidebar also gets a collapsible Session Timeline section (cards styled like the running-chats section).

settings.label: 最多条数
settings.hint: 按修改时间取最近 N 条（跨全部项目）
settings.hintEn: Take the N most recent sessions by modified time (across all projects)
